articles.summary: Announces NYSE Ticker Symbol Change to “MPT” Effective February 2, 2026 Medical Properties Trust, Inc. (the “Company” or “MPT”) (NYSE: MPW) today published a letter to shareholders from its Chairman, President, and Chief Executive Officer, Edward K. Aldag, Jr., outlining several key branding initiatives in 2026 as the Company celebrates its 20 th year as a publicly traded company. As part of this update to its brand, MPT has changed its ticker symbol from “MPW” to “MPT” on the New York Stock Exc
articles.title: Medical Properties Trust Issues Letter to Shareholders Regarding Branding Refresh
